posts.title: Google Cloud Generative AI Leader Certification Preparation Guide
posts.description: The Google Cloud Generative AI Leader exam is about making sound business decisions with generative AI. It is intended for people across business and technical roles, with or without hands-on experience. The exam tests whether you can recognize useful opportunities, understand Google Cloud’s offerings, and guide responsible adoption. It does not ask you to implement a model or build an application

posts.title: Jev Plays Chess: Building a Decision Harness Around a Model
posts.description: Jev is TypeSafe AI’s first public System One model . It is built to answer typed questions with structured decisions. That makes it a natural fit for a game: ask it to choose among legal moves, then let ordinary code apply the answer. In this article we explore Jev Chess a small TypeScript web app that uses Jev plays chess. An experiment exploring how to put a constrained decision model in a loop.

posts.title: Build and Train a MiniGPT with JAX
posts.description: In this article, we will build a workflow for training a language-model using JAX ecosystem. Specifically, we will build a compact GPT-style language model with JAX and Flax NNX, train it on a small text dataset called TinyStories, use Orbax for checkpointing, and run text generation from the restored model. flowchart LR A[TinyStories text] --> B[GPT-2 tokenizer] B --> C[Fixed-length token batches
